title: The review-stream overlay covers 57 of 114 active tickets, and DEV-PROCESS still says 'nothing left over'
description:
## BLUF

**The review-stream overlay Kam adopted on 2026-09-03 now covers exactly half the board, and** `DEV-PROCESS.md` **still says it covers all of it.** A handover organised by stream today silently omits **22 of the 32** PR-bearing tickets.

## Measured, 2026-09-09

`DEV-PROCESS.md` §*The four review streams, built 2026-09-03* states:

> All **97** active Platform K tickets now sit under four parents — 40 + 19 + 18 + 20, nothing left over

Today, over `state.type in (started, unstarted)` on team KS:

|  | count |
| -- | -- |
| active Platform K tickets | **114** |
| directly under a review-stream parent | **57** (KS-485 19 · KS-772 15 · KS-770 12 · KS-771 11) |
| under some other parent | 5 |
| **no parent at all** | **52** |
| **NOT under a review stream** | **57 of 114** |

The doc's per-parent figures (40/19/18/20) do not match any parent's current child count either.

## Why it bites right now

Building the review blocks for Kam's handover, **22 of the 32 tickets that carry an open PR have no stream parent** — including every one of today's ready items: KS-926, KS-963, KS-968, KS-991, KS-992, KS-993, KS-1026, KS-936, KS-942, KS-945, KS-961, KS-909, KS-931, KS-791, KS-798/799/841, KS-764, KS-682, KS-971, KS-229, KS-1004.

The rule in the same doc is *"Every new K-side ticket that reaches Todo is parented into one of the four"*. That step is not happening — and nothing fails when it is skipped, which is why it went unnoticed for six days. **Same family as KS-926: a rule with no check behind it.**

⚠ There is also a **discoverability trap in the doc's own shape**: three parents are findable by title (`Review stream: …`) but the fourth, **KS-485**, is titled *"Security review — plan, methodology & handover (Platform K)"*. A title search for review-stream parents returns **3 of 4**. This session hit exactly that and only caught KS-485 by reading DEV-PROCESS.

## Checklist

- [ ] Parent the 22 PR-bearing tickets into their stream (placement already derived per-PR in the s159 review-block report — reuse it rather than re-deriving)
- [ ] Sweep the remaining unparented active tickets (52 total with no parent)
- [ ] Correct the counts in `DEV-PROCESS.md` §*The four review streams* — or, better, stop hardcoding a number that decays and point at a query
- [ ] Rename KS-485 so all four parents are findable by title, **or** name all four explicitly in the doc so a title search is not the discovery path
- [ ] Decide where the check lives so an unparented Todo cannot sit unnoticed — the board equivalent of KS-926's census

## Provenance

Linear GraphQL, team KS, `state.type in (started, unstarted)`, direct `parent` field. PR->ticket map from the 43 open PRs. Measured 2026-09-09 by the Platform K s159 seat.

nodes.body: **BLUF:** Delivered: PR 1136 merged as f372149518f8 on develop (item 3 only); no deploy surface (docs only: Blockchain/Dev/docs/DEV-PROCESS.md, the squash's only file). Verified by docs read: `Blockchain/Dev/docs/DEV-PROCESS.md:219` carries the corrected, decayed-count wording from that PR. Left open: the parenting work is not done. The description still lists five unchecked items when read today, among them parenting the 22 PR-bearing tickets into their stream and sweeping the remaining unparented active tickets, and nothing on the ticket records them done.
